title: No pagination on GET /books
evidence: app.py:104 returns the full table unconditionally (SELECT * FROM books)
suggestion: Optional: add ?limit/?offset — not required by the spec

title: year field is not type-validated
evidence: app.py:79 year = data.get('year') is stored as-is; a non-integer year (e.g. "abc") persists as text
suggestion: Optionally coerce/validate year as int; spec only mandates title/author validation

title: init_db() runs as an import side effect creating books.db in cwd
evidence: app.py:166 calls init_db() at module load, writing the default books.db file on import
suggestion: Guard schema creation behind __main__ or an app factory to avoid touching the filesystem on import
